data.title: 爱西亚 · 暖融厨房里的下午茶烘焙时光
data.description: 午后阳光斜照的温馨厨房，爱西亚身着米白针织开衫与鹅黄长裙，端着用小隔热手套捧着的刚出炉香甜曲奇，眼眸闪烁期待。
data.action: 双手戴着可爱猫咪隔热手套端着烤盘，微微探身展示热气腾腾的刚烤好的点心
data.lighting: 窗台射入的暖融阳光，点心烤炉的橙色余温
data.camera: 中近景正面视线，营造面对面品尝甜点的亲昵感
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, asia argento, long blonde hair with green hair ribbon, emerald green eyes, cream knit cardigan over soft yellow long dress, wearing cute oven mitts holding baking tray of freshly baked golden cookies, sweet shy smile leaning slightly forward, warm bright domestic kitchen, afternoon sunlight, delightful homey warmth.
